user.title: Add a window
user.description: Sun hours are calculated from your home location (Settings → System → General), the same one the Sun integration uses. Obstacles such as buildings, trees or balconies are not taken into account, but you can narrow the angle range to leave out a blocked side.

data_description.name: For example Living room window. Entities are named after it.
data_description.azimuth: Compass direction the window faces, looking out: 0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west.
data_description.min_angle: Lowest sun angle that reaches the glass, measured from the wall as you look out: 0° is along the wall to your left, 90° straight ahead, 180° along the wall to your right. Default 1°.
data_description.max_angle: Highest sun angle that reaches the glass, on the same scale. Default 179°. Narrow the range if a side wall, a reveal or a neighbouring wing blocks one side.
data_description.floor: Floor the window is on, numbered the local way.
data_description.ground_floor: How floors are numbered where you live.

error.angle_order: The maximum angle must be greater than the minimum angle.
